Scenario fixture: server-side-image-map-absent (server-side image maps need a keyboard-operable alternative)

Each target <img> has a stable id of the form ssim_case_NN. An <img ismap> inside a link is asked about, since the rule cannot see whether its destinations are also offered as links; no ismap at all is a pass.

A. Asked about

01 — CANTTELL: img with ismap, inside a link

B. Not flagged (not counted; see the rule's own tests for the page-level outcome)

02 — NEUTRAL: ordinary image, no ismap attribute
03 — NEUTRAL: client-side image map (usemap), not flagged by this rule
04 — NEUTRAL: ismap outside a link does nothing, so it is not a server-side image map

End of fixture.
